normal.name: Arda Kılıçdağı
normal.text: Weekend chilling with my AYN Thor (Max): Playing Castlevania: Dawn of Sorrow. GBA / NDS / 3DS were lost generations for me (I was a hardcore PC gamer back then), so trying to catch up feels nice for these generations. It has Amoled touch screen, mine has 8 cores + 16gbs RAM, 1TB SSD. It can even emulate Switch games, plus it literally can play PC games using GameNative/Winlator etc, just like Steam Deck. It can even emulate PS3 and Xbox360. https://www.ayntec.com/products/ayn-thor?variant=46692546838720 #aynthor #retrogaming
normal.media: image: My AYN Thor retro handheld, playing Castlevania: Dawn of Sorrow

normal.name: K~
normal.text: I own a bunch of DOS games from GOG. Unfortunately, all of these are bundled with a Windows version of DOSBox only. I'd like to use a linux version. But which one? Apparently there are two 'modern' versions of DOSBox; called "DOSBox-x" and "DOSBox Staging". I'm wondering if anyone has any experience / recommendations about this. (Otherwise I'll just pick on at random.) #retrogaming #dos #linux #linux_gaming
